items.promptText: Clean digital cinema image with low noise, fine detail, wide dynamic range and a soft roll-off into the highlights.
35mm film look with fine organic grain, gentle halation around bright highlights, rich dense color and a soft highlight roll-off.
16mm film look with visible coarse grain, softer detail, slightly lifted blacks and muted warm color.
8mm home-movie look with heavy grain, soft focus, faint flicker and gate weave, faded warm color and darkened corners.
Early-2000s standard-definition digital video look with crisp edge sharpening, flat contrast, clipped bright highlights and a slightly cool cast.
Crisp modern rendering, sharp from edge to edge, with high micro-contrast, neutral round bokeh and no flare or distortion.
Anamorphic widescreen rendering with oval bokeh, horizontal streak flares across bright lights and a gentle falloff toward the frame edges.
Vintage anamorphic rendering, softer and lower in contrast, with stretched oval bokeh, warm horizontal flares and smeared, curved frame edges.
Warm vintage rendering with a soft focus roll-off, gentle contrast, creamy amber tones and softly glowing skin.
Glowing vintage rendering where bright highlights bloom into soft halos and veiling flare lifts the shadows into a dreamy haze.
Very shallow depth of field, the subject in crisp focus against a background melted into large, soft bokeh.
Moderate depth of field, the subject sharp and the nearby background readable but gently soft.
Deep focus, with foreground, subject and background all sharp and detailed.
The camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward the subject, tightening the frame.
The camera pulls back slowly from the subject, widening the frame to reveal the surroundings.
The camera tracks alongside the moving subject at the same pace, keeping them in frame as the background slides past.
The camera pans smoothly sideways from a fixed position, sweeping across the scene.
The camera rises smoothly upward, ending on a high angle that looks down over the scene.
The camera descends smoothly from a high angle down to eye level with the subject.
The camera orbits halfway around the subject in a smooth arc, keeping them centered as the background swings behind them.
The camera is handheld, with subtle natural shake and small reframing drifts that give an urgent, documentary feel.
The camera whips sideways in a fast pan with heavy motion blur, snapping onto the next point of interest.
The camera holds its framing while the focus shifts from the foreground to the background, pulling attention to what was blurred.
Point-of-view shot through the character's own eyes, the camera moving with their head and gaze.
The camera stays completely still on a locked-off frame; only the subject moves.

wet streets and window glass catching small bright reflections, subjects framed at eye level in medium and close shots, most of the frame left in shadow with one small pool of light, rain streaks visible against lit windows, doorways and railings crossing the foreground

one or two people in a plain room framed from the waist up, faces held in close view for long moments, everyday objects such as cups, coats and chairs behind them, almost no camera movement, a little empty space left beside whoever is speaking

wide frames with large empty areas of dark space, a doorway or corridor at the far end of the image, the subject small and off to one side, something partly hidden at the very edge of the frame, few low light sources, camera moving very slowly toward the dark area

rooms full of dials, screens and cables laid out in straight lines and symmetrical rows, a person small beside large machinery, light from screens falling across nearby surfaces, wide establishing frames followed by tight shots of hands and displays

wide landscapes with a small figure or vehicle crossing the frame, horizon placed very low or very high so sky or ground fills most of the image, a road or ridge line leading into the distance, camera tracking beside or behind the traveler, dust or mist in the air

camera held at shoulder height with a slight natural sway, only the light that already exists in the place, people going about a task while the frame follows a beat late, activity visible in the background, heads sometimes cut off at the frame edge

evenly lit sets in daylight, wide lens close to the subjects so edges stretch slightly, props and hand gestures large in the frame, centered or symmetrical compositions, quick small reactions held in tight shots, uncluttered backgrounds
two people close together, shallow depth of field, faces and hands filling the frame, one small lamp
soft glow spreading from bright spots, corners darker than the center, low contrast with milky blacks, faint brightness flicker from frame to frame, small dust specks drifting across the image
colors at very high saturation with strong contrast between hues, soft diffusion on highlights, skin glowing in even bright light, stage-like lighting with few deep shadows
fine film grain visible across dark areas, soft glow around bright lights, blacks slightly lifted to dark grey, gentle softening toward the frame corners, midtones leaning warm
soft low-resolution detail, faint horizontal scan lines, color bleeding at bright edges, blooming highlights
sharp detail from edge to edge, no visible grain, full range from deep shadow to bright highlight without clipping, skin tones as the eye sees them, no lens flare
camera locked on a tripod for the whole shot, people moving slowly inside the frame, long pauses between small actions, no camera movement
camera creeping forward or sideways slower than a walking pace, people taking small steps one at a time, background objects sliding slowly across the frame
almost no movement for most of the shot, then a sudden fast push of the camera or a quick movement by the subject in the last second
camera moving fast with quick pans and push-ins, people acting at a fast pace, a new action starting about every second, tight framing with abrupt changes of direction
shadows and backgrounds in deep slate blue, midtones in muted steel blue, highlights kept a pale cool grey, only small lamp-lit spots breaking the scheme
lit areas in amber and honey, mid-shadows in reddish brown, deepest shadows near black with a brown tint, skin and wood carrying most of the orange, no blue anywhere in the frame
shadows and backgrounds pushed toward green-blue, skin, brick, metal and lights pushed toward rust orange, the two hues kept apart so each object reads as one or the other, highlights a pale sand
image reduced to black, warm paper white and greys with no other hue, large areas of solid black, bright areas limited to faces and light sources, a hard boundary between lit and shadowed zones

background in near-black blue, magenta and cyan lights from signs and screens, reflections of those two colors stretched across wet ground and glass, faces split with magenta on one side and cyan on the other, small white points for lamps

foliage and walls in muted olive and moss green, distant areas fading to pale grey-green as if behind thin fog, shadows in dark green-black, almost no saturated color except one small detail such as a lit window

colors washed out to pale sand, grey and faded blue, bright overexposed sky and surfaces, skin slightly pale, dark areas lifted to mid-grey instead of black, thin traces of color only in clothing and objects

most of the frame in black and deep maroon, bright areas in glowing orange-red as if lit by fire or heater coils, faces catching red-orange on the lit side, object edges outlined in thin orange, no green or blue
bright pale blue and white across most of the frame, shadows in clear mid blue rather than grey, snow-white highlights, deep navy only in small dark objects, skin slightly cool
sky and background in dusty purple, shadows in dark violet, highlights in pale pink, a thin band of peach near the horizon or around lamps, no pure black anywhere
bright daylight with pastel pink, sky blue, butter yellow and mint in broad even areas, white highlights, soft thin shadows in pale lilac, no black areas
ground, walls and dust in ochre and earthy yellow-brown, shadows in burnt umber, sky bleached to a pale dusty cream, skin sun-darkened with orange tones, no green and almost no blue

soft daylight entering from a window on one side of the frame, a single key light, the far side of faces and objects falling into deep shadow with a soft edge, a faint bounce of light from the wall on the shadow side
one visible lamp as the only light, a small pool on faces and table, the room near black
a hard light directly overhead, sharp-edged shadows under brows, nose and chin, eye sockets dark, a tight circle of light on the floor or table, everything outside the circle black

strong light placed behind the subject facing the camera, a thin bright rim along hair and shoulders, the face in shadow with only a faint fill from the front, haze or dust in the air showing the beam

faces and hands lit from below and in front by screens and indicator panels, soft-edged light with a short reach, small points of indicator lights in the dark behind, no other light source in the room

even light from a cloudy sky coming from above and all around, almost no cast shadows, soft gradients on faces, surfaces readable everywhere including dark corners, no bright highlights and no lens flare

sun low near the horizon on one side, light raking across the ground and walls, long stretched shadows pointing away from the sun, bright edges on the lit side of faces, the far side in shade, haze in the air
